```
// Rung 0: ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// CIP AXIS STATE //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

 - ENUMERATION :

   0 = Initializing
   1 = Pre-Charge
   2 = Stopped
   3 = Starting
   4 = Running
   5 = Testing
   6 = Stopping
   7 = Aborting
   8 = Faulted
   9 = Start Inhibited
   10 = Shutdown
   11 = Axis Inhibited
   12 = Not Grouped
   13 = No Module
   14...255 = Reserved
MOV(Ref_Axis_CD.CIPAxisState,Out_AxisCipState);

// Rung 1: //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

 - SECTION AXIS ENABLE
```

```
16:

else if ONSR_TAG1[0].OutputBit and RejectFlag1.[Index] then

		Production_Counts.RejectCounts1[Index]:=Production_Counts.RejectCounts1[Index]+1;

	end_if;

end_if;

if RejectONSR_TAG2[Index].OutputBit then

else if ONSR_TAG2[0].OutputBit and RejectFlag2.[Index] then

37: 
	end_if;

38:

39: 


40: 
end_for;

41: 


42: 


43:

45:
```

```
[XIC(Ref_Transactions[0].Diagnostic.Overload) ,XIC(Ref_Transactions[1].Diagnostic.Overload) ,XIC(Ref_Transactions[2].Diagnostic.Overload) ,XIC(Ref_Transactions[3].Diagnostic.Overload) ,XIC(Ref_Transactions[4].Diagnostic.Overload) ]XIC(Inp_Enable)XIO(Sts_Faulted)OTE(Sts_Overload);
```

```
// Rung 1
[XIC(FluffReadyFlag) OTE(FluffSplicerPumpWork) XIC(Pulse.3) ,XIC(FluffSplicerFlag) ]OTE(STS_MCU:6:O.2);

// Rung 2
XIO(STS_MCU:3:I.4)XIC(FluffReadyFlag)XIC(fluffsplicepulse)ONS(ONS2.0)CTU(FluffPulpFinishDelay,?,?);

// Rung 3
[XIC(STS_MCU:2:I.2) ,XIC(ONS2.6) ,XIC(FluffPulpFinishDelay.DN) ]ONS(ONS2.1)XIC(MachineStatus.2)XIC(FluffReadyFlag)[OTL(FluffSplicerFlag) ,OTL(STS_MCU:7:O.0) ];

// Rung 4
XIC(FluffSplicerFlag)XIC(MachineStatus.12)ONS(ONS2.2)ADD(FluffSplicerCOUNT,1,FluffSplicerCOUNT);

// Rung 5
XIC(FluffSplicerFlag)ONS(ONS2.3)OTU(FluffReadyFlag)RES(FluffPulpFinishDelay);

// Rung 6
CPT(FluffSpliceSpeedDownSetting1,1000/(FluffSettingWeight/(FluffDensitySetting*FluffWidthSetting/1000000)));

// Rung 7
AFI()GRT(FluffSplicerCOUNT,8)OTL(STS_MCU:7:O.1);

// Rung 8
CPT(CompresCylinderDownSetting,975/(FluffSettingWeight/(FluffDensitySetting*FluffWidthSetting/1000000)));

// Rung 9

// Rung 10
CPT(ConveyorCylinderUpSetting,990/(FluffSettingWeight/(FluffDensitySetting*FluffWidthSetting/1000000)));

// Rung 11
AFI()GEQ(FluffSplicerCOUNT,13)OTU(STS_MCU:7:O.1);

// Rung 12
ADD(FluffSplicerSetting,10,CompresCylinderUpSetting);

// Rung 13
GEQ(FluffSplicerCOUNT,CompresCylinderDownSetting)AFI()OTL(STS_MCU:7:O.2);

// Rung 14
AFI()EQU(FluffSplicerCOUNT,30)OTU(STS_MCU:7:O.2);

// Rung 15
AFI()EQU(FluffSplicerCOUNT,45)OTL(STS_MCU:7:O.2);

// Rung 16
AFI()GEQ(FluffSplicerCOUNT,CompresCylinderUpSetting)OTU(STS_MCU:7:O.2);

// Rung 17
CPT(FluffSplicerSetting,2800/(FluffSettingWeight/(FluffDensitySetting*FluffWidthSetting/1000000)));

// Rung 18
XIC(MachineStatus.2)GEQ(FluffSplicerCOUNT,FluffSplicerSetting)XIC(FluffSplicerFlag)[CPT(AxisParameter[22].GearRatio,FluffSettingWeight/(FluffDensitySetting*FluffWidthSetting/1000000)/2) ,CPT(AxisParameter[23].GearRatio,FluffSettingWeight/(FluffDensitySetting*FluffWidthSetting/1000000)/2) ];

// Rung 20
XIC(MachineStatus.2)XIO(FluffSplicerFlag)[CPT(AxisParameter[22].GearRatio,FluffSettingWeight/(FluffDensitySetting*FluffWidthSetting/1000000)) ,CPT(AxisParameter[23].GearRatio,FluffSettingWeight/(FluffDensitySetting*FluffWidthSetting/1000000)) ];

// Rung 21
```
